steps.run:
set +e
dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/triage"; mkdir -p "$dir"; : > "$dir/failed.log"
api="repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID/jobs"
gh api "$api" --paginate --jq '.jobs[] | select(.conclusion=="failure") | .id' > "$dir/jobs.txt" 2> "$dir/gh-error.txt"
gh api "$api" --paginate --jq '.jobs[] | select(.conclusion=="failure") | .name as $j | .steps[] | select(.conclusion=="failure") | "\($j) / \(.name)"' 2>> "$dir/gh-error.txt" | head -20 | sed 's/^/::notice title=failed step::/'
for id in $(cat "$dir/jobs.txt"); do
  curl -sSL -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" "https://api.github.com/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/jobs/$id/logs" 2>> "$dir/gh-error.txt" | sed -E 's/^[^0-9]*[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+Z //' >> "$dir/failed.log"
done
node scripts/ci-failure-triage.cjs --job legacy --base release-base --log "$dir/failed.log" --out "$dir/triage-legacy.json" --annotate
echo "::notice title=digest input::failed jobs=$(wc -l < "$dir/jobs.txt") log bytes=$(wc -c < "$dir/failed.log") log lines=$(wc -l < "$dir/failed.log") first api error=$(head -c 160 "$dir/gh-error.txt" | tr '\n' ' ')"
exit 0
